title: How to Leave The Mall World, a Guide

classification.theory_summary: Provides spiritual/consent-based steps (prayer, affirmations, retracting 'soul-contracts') to leave/avoid 'The Mall World' and other 'astral realms' during sleep.
classification.skip_reason: No specific dream narrative, locations visited, spatial layout, or events are described—only prescriptive guidance/affirmations about leaving 'The Mall World'.

meta.author_theory: Prayer can instantly remove you from 'The Mall World' or other 'astral realms' during sleep; being there is framed as based on consent (including past-life consent) that can be retracted via affirmations/'soul-contract' revocations.

extraction.extraction_notes: Phenomenological content is limited to general claims about being 'in The Mall World' during sleep and that prayer/affirmations remove you; no describable scenes, entities, or spatial features are provided.
